ut_7even_sloth.approach: The wall is a bolted, north-facing drytool crag along the western end of the Devil's Castle north face, in a boxy recess above the main rock-climbing area and before the base of the Hellevator Shaft. From the upper parking area by the campground (or on foot from the Alta base), walk through the campground and past the cabins onto the Devil's Castle loop trail, and leave it at a bend where small mine tailings sit beside the path. A climbers' trail climbs talus to the foot of the castle, then trends right past the standard rock routes and up loose scree to the recess holding the wall. The rock below is loose, so wear a helmet. Sloth is the leftmost line on the wall.

ut_7even_wrath.descent_text: Finish at the chains and lower to the ground.
